node.title: Re^2: Simple web server to ingest POST
node.author: 23skiddoo
node.doctext: Hey, thanks for your response! I gave that a shot, and after a couple of tweaks (due to copy/paste errors), it seems to have worked! Do you have any recommendations for fleshing it out? I can include a sub to parse the $dom after the app->start, yeah? (It would take the contents and push it up into another system's API.) What's best practice for running a Mojo server as a service so I can avoid manually starting it?
